RelationDefinition.description: Defines the semantic and traversal rules for a specific relationship type in the knowledge graph.

RelationPolicyRegistry.description: Registry of access and traversal policies for relation types.

EdgeEvidence.description: Provenance and evidence supporting an edge.

DirectScoreComponents.description: Explicit scoring components for an edge or path. No hidden LLM weights.

PathCandidate.description: A potential traversal path evaluated for scoring.

PathDecision.description: The final decision on whether a PathCandidate is accepted or rejected.

BlockingReason.description: Reason why a path or edge was blocked during traversal.

ExplanationPayload.description: Detailed explanation for accepted or rejected paths.
